This '''''Consular''-class cruiser''' was part of the Republic garrison that was sent to [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] to defend [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] interests and Scipio's neutrality. It was accompanied by several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships and dozens of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|Clone shock troopers]].

==History==
This cruiser was deployed to Scipio just prior to the [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|invasion of Scipio]]. It was later destroyed in the Separatist assault, by a trio of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|Hyena-class bombers]].<ref name="Crisis at the Heart">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>

==Appearances==
*{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} {{1st}}
